Job Profiles-Oriented Training

ADVANCED TRAINING - Develop Industry-relevant and Job-specific Knowledge & Skills

Being one of the top PGDM & MBA colleges in Pune and Maharashtra, and one of the top MBA schools in India, Pune Institute of Business Management (PIBM) offers job profile-based training to management students. As per your specialization, the curriculum ensures you get training in the most in-demand job profiles. Domains like Finance, Marketing, HR, Operations, Business Analytics, Consulting, and more are covered during the program for job-based training for better career growth. PIBM is the only B-School in Pune and even in Maharashtra that focuses on training students & developing key job skills required for niche or specific job profiles in various domains.
Select a career path according to your specialization, and it’s on PIBM to make you job-ready from Day 1 of your Corporate Career. Pursuing advanced PGDM and MBA programs from the Pune Institute of Business Management, Pune, trains you for diverse & specific job profiles. The job-oriented curriculum makes PIBM Pune one of the best MBA colleges in Pune with good placements for the students in the domains, including MBA in Marketing, MBA in Finance, MBA in HR, MBA in Digital Marketing, MBA in Analytics, as well as students pursuing PGDM in Pune.

Have Questions?

FAQs

What is the difference between PGDM and MBA at PIBM?

PGDM is an AICTE-approved, AIU recognised industry-oriented program, while MBA is an SPPU-affiliated degree program.

What specializations are available?

Major - Marketing, Finance, HR, Business Analytics. Minor - Analytics & Operation.

What is the eligibility for admission?

A graduation degree with 50% marks and a valid entrance score (CAT/MAT/XAT/PMAT/CMAT/MH-CET).

What is the admission process?

Apply online → Submit scores →Written Test → GD/PI → Final selection.

Does PIBM offer placement assistance?

Yes, PIBM provides 100% placement support with training and interviews through 1000+ recruiters.

Which companies recruit from PIBM?

Top companies like Deloitte, PWC, BNY, BP, Barclays, E&Y, Accenture, Capgemini etc.

Are internships included?

Yes, both programs include Summer & Winter Internships and live projects.

What is the duration of the programs?

Both PGDM and MBA are full-time 2-year programs.

Is hostel accommodation available?

Yes, PIBM provides safe, well-equipped hostels for both boys and girls.

Do students get corporate exposure?

Yes, through corporate sessions, workshops, internships, and live projects.

--

About PIBM

Pune Institute of Business Management (PIBM) is one of the top B-Schools in India where our aim is to provide high-value business management education to produce educated and skilled Management Graduates. PIBM stands tall amidst B-Schools in India because not only do we focus on the highest standards of academics but also train students with skillsets making them shine in the corporate world. Established in 2007 and spread across 18 Acres, PIBM is strategically located in a calm and serene valley on the outskirts of Pune.

PIBM provides Post Graduate courses in Management at the Pune campus. Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) which is an AICTE approved course is the flagship program at PIBM Pune. PIBM also offers a Master in Business Administration (MBA) course in affiliation to Savitribai Phule Pune University. In recent years, PIBM has expanded by opening up Campus for Graduation Courses - BBA, B.Com & BCA in Guwahati (Assam).

About PIBM  Management

Chairman's Message

The vision of the institute is that “Every student passing out from the institute must contribute to the economy of India & whole world by becoming a business leader - either by joining to lead a company or becoming a successful entrepreneur creating employment”, entail students undergo character and personality building program. As an institute focusing on providing quality education, we believe in setting up unique training methodologies which gears towards competency and confidence building in the students which in turn increases Employability. We believe in building management careers on a solid foundation of Practical & Experience based learning rather than just Classroom Theories. We follow a very simple yet standardized process of training our students where we build Logic and Skills.

Mr. Raman Preet
Founder & Chairman
PIBM Group of Institutes

--
Building Skill

Students then get to implement their strategies & models developed during training process at various companies especially those where processes are not implemented yet, during their multiple stints through Live Business Projects & Internships. Sector understanding enhances student's macro knowledge of industry and strategic thinking while understanding micro specific details about product/service would make them perfect business executor. So, PIBM students have perfect blend of forming business strategy and executing them efficiently and effectively. We majorly focus on developing the concentration of mind which increases the willpower. Students with this increased concentration and willpower, grasps the knowledge and facts quickly and easily. With the training provided and developed skills and concentration, PIBM students achieve their goals. Students spend their time with Mentors who are corporate heads and senior faculty, discussing about doubts and problems they have. In addition to the academic and intellectual input, adequate stress is laid in inculcating the traits of leadership and team spirit in order to facilitate students to realize their full potential. At PIBM, Quality speaks for itself. Every student of PIBM stands out in the crowd as they are not only equipped with Business Concepts but also the right attitude, competencies, aptitude, communication, skills and personality.

-- -->

Director’s Message - PGDM

PIBM's mission is to provide opportunities to aspiring future leaders from various parts of the country who have strong academic backgrounds but need exposure to management training. We transform our students into top-notch professionals through our two-year Post Graduate Program in Management, focusing on domain knowledge, aptitude, analytical skills, self-confidence, positive attitude, soft skills, and communication abilities. Our goal is to support students in realizing their ambitions of joining management professions and achieving their dreams of managerial careers. Our procedures, systems, pedagogy, faculty, and infrastructure are all designed to support this mission. Students actively participate in the institution's activities alongside faculty and staff.

Dr. Mahendra Narayan More
Acting Director - PGDM

At PIBM, advanced training methods are employed to teach and prepare our students, making them industry-ready. Every student gains exposure to companies from various sectors through classroom teaching and practical experiences, such as summer internships, winter internships, live projects, and industry visits. Each weekend, corporate leaders from different sectors spend the day with our students for experience sharing and training.

Our commitment is to our students' development, growth, and excellent training to meet the industry's growing demands. Our mission is to create corporate leaders with guidance from the best faculty in both academia and the corporate world. We strive to achieve greater success through quality teaching and training in a competitive and ever-changing environment.

--

Dr. R Priya
Director – MBA
Pune Institute of Business Management

Director’s Message - MBA

Our vision is to become a leading business school dedicated to developing competent management professionals capable of managing and leading organizations effectively.

Our mission is comprehensive and multi-faceted, aimed at serving our stakeholders through a commitment to competency-based teaching, proactive community outreach, rigorous research, and enhanced employability. We prioritize our students’ success and organizational effectiveness through thorough student mentoring, continuous curriculum development, and strategic industry collaborations.

At PIBM Pune, we believe in fostering a learning environment that not only imparts knowledge but also equips our students with the practical skills and ethical foundations necessary to excel in the dynamic world of business. Our dedicated faculty, robust academic programs, and extensive industry partnerships are all designed to prepare our students to become visionary leaders and innovative thinkers.
